findings.title: BIM Change Detection postgres executeQuery SQLi via JSON.stringify single-quote breakout
findings.description: Update Database node uses INSERT ... '{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}'. JSON.stringify does not escape single quotes. Compare returns full element dicts from extract stdout into $json. IFC-derived name/id containing '); DROP... breaks the SQL string. Distinct from already-reported executeCommand RCE; survives argv-safe command fixes.
findings.impact: Writer to /models can DROP/alter model_changes (and other tables if multi-statement allowed), falsifying BIM change history.
findings.attack_path:
1. Deploy BIM Change Detection as written.
2. Drop evil.ifc under /models with element name Wall '); DROP TABLE model_changes;--
3. extract → Compare puts elem in changes.added.
4. executeQuery interpolates JSON.stringify($json); embedded ' terminates literal; DROP runs.
findings.remediation: Parameterized postgres insert / queryReplacement; never interpolate JSON into SQL.
